the "continue" action effect of form of mist/shadow body is canceled if
ANOTHER minion uses fast reaction at the end of this combat =)

> another one, in 1.6.3.3 says that when a minion is burned the
> retainers and equipment is also burned, but if its burned by diablerie
> the biabolizing minion can get that cards no (as says in 6.5.5)? the
> ratainers canot be taken?

when a minion is burned, all cards on him are burned, with a few exceptions
(charnas the imp...)
If he's diablerized, the diabolist can only take equipment from him.
Retainers cannot be stolen during a diablerie. Maybe because they didn't fit
in the vampire's pocket ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Geb wrote:
>
> hello all
>
> if a minion uses a s:ce that continues his action (such as shadow body
> sup) and the blocking minion uses a fast reaction at the end of the
> combat what happens?

Blocking minion cannot Fast React, but some other minion could.

> did the action continues?

No the continuance effect is lost.

> the action is again blocked and the is a new combat?

There is a new combat, but the action is not "reblocked" - is simply
doesn't continue.

> another one, in 1.6.3.3 says that when a minion is burned the
> retainers and equipment is also burned, but if its burned by diablerie
> the biabolizing minion can get that cards no (as says in 6.5.5)? the
> ratainers canot be taken?

Retainers cannot be taken.
